name: Afro
source:
Likes: Fashion, Freedom
Dislikes: His life
Age: ???
Afro is the town garbageman. He feeds Mario every day.
Afro wishes Mario would leave the town dump, but he won’t. Afro is absolutely miserable. Nobody even remembers his name.
